body:
## Why
In this repo `hkb init` copied `skills/kanban/` into `.agents/skills/kanban/` (tracked). PR #16 changed `skills/kanban/references/protocol.md` and the copy now lags. Two sources of truth is exactly what the design forbids.

## What
- In `src/init.js`: when the repo being initialised *is* the hkb package itself (a `package.json` with `"name": "hkb"` at the root), make `.agents/skills/kanban` a relative symlink to `../../skills/kanban` instead of a copy; keep the `.claude/skills/kanban` symlink as is.
- For other repos keep the copy, but record the installed skill version (`metadata.version` from SKILL.md) in `.kanban/board.json` and have `hkb doctor` warn when the installed copy is older than the package's.
- Replace the current copy in this repo with the symlink in the same PR.

## Done when
`hkb doctor` is clean, `git ls-files .agents` shows the symlink, and the docs read the same from both paths.
title: Self-hosting: .agents/skills/kanban must not be a stale copy of skills/kanban
